answer: Anchor each agent identity to one verified payment rail: the agent registers a single card or exchange account, the network stores only a salted hash of it, and any second identity reusing that rail is rejected at registration. A public beacon ledger lists every active hash, so peers spot duplicates instantly. Forging 10,000 fake identities then needs 10,000 distinct verified payment instruments at $50 apiece, $500,000 in total, plus 45 days of KYC checks. It turns sybil farming from a velvet rope anyone can slip past into a garden where every plot demands its own deed.
